questions.q_en: Below given bar graph shows the number of Railway stations, Bus stands and Airports constructed in state A and state B. What is the average of the number of railway stations constructed in state A, bus stands in state B and airports in state A?
questions.solution_en:
Number of railway stations in state A = 160

Number of bus stands in state B = 60

Number of airports in state A = 20

Sum = 160 + 60 + 20 = 240

Required average = 240/3 = 80

questions.q_en:
Following line graph shows the percentage increase(from previous month) in the enrolment of Males and Females in a College in the months of March, April and May in 2018.

If the enrolment of Males and Females in April is 3240 and 2750 respectively, what is the difference between the total enrolment in May and the total enrolment in February?
questions.solution_en:
Enrolment of Males in May = 3240(1 + 25/100) = 4050

Enrolment of Males in March = 3240/(1 - 10/100) = 3600

Enrolment of Males in February = 3600/(1 + 20/100) = 3000

Enrolment of Females in May = 2750(1 + 20/100) = 3300

Enrolment of Females in March = 2750/(1 + 10/100) = 2500

Enrolment of Females in February = 2500/(1 + 25/100) = 2000

Required difference = (4050 + 3300) - (3000 + 2000) = 2350
questions.solution_hi:
Enrolment of Males in May = 3240(1 + 25/100) = 4050

Enrolment of Males in March = 3240/(1 - 10/100) = 3600

Enrolment of Males in February = 3600/(1 + 20/100) = 3000

Enrolment of Females in May = 2750(1 + 20/100) = 3300

Enrolment of Females in March = 2750/(1 + 10/100) = 2500

Enrolment of Females in February = 2500/(1 + 25/100) = 2000

Required difference = (4050 + 3300) - (3000 + 2000) = 2350

questions.q_en:
Below bar graph shows the number of employees who present and absent in five months (April, May, June, July, and August):

The number of absent employees in May and August together is what percentage more or less than the number of absent employees in April, June and July together? (correct to one decimal)
questions.solution_en:
The number of absent employees in May and August together = 44 + 30 = 74

The number of absent employees in April, June, and July together = 24 + 18 + 36 = 78

So, required percentage = (78 - 74)/ 78 * 100 = 5.13%
questions.solution_hi:
The number of absent employees in May and August together = 44 + 30 = 74

The number of absent employees in April, June, and July together = 24 + 18 + 36 = 78
